known_limitations.description: Protocol anomaly promotion and outbound-volume baseline detection are not e2e-verified. Run one replica; local cohort history resets on restart and late observations are excluded. No existing ATT&CK mapping for category anomaly.
Unit/state test sources (not golden-PCAP evidence): services/anomaly-detector/test_anomaly.py
Measured quality is computed by services/feedback-service/quality.py (KTD2); static confidence weights are not measured precision or false-positive rates.

sensor_checksum_rejection is a sensor-health signal, not a detection: it is a dominance heuristic reporting that invalid-checksum anomalies outnumbered every other anomaly one sensor reported over a window. It does not measure the share of traffic affected (the denominator is anomaly events, not packets, and the engine throttles events), does not establish that the capture path is unhealthy (a sensor reporting few other anomaly types can cross the threshold on sporadic corruption), cannot read the sensor's configuration, and cannot prove traffic went uninspected; confirmation needs the sensor's running config or stats counters, not a change in this share. Shares are per-replica because each replica tallies only its assigned partitions. The checksum_validation_suspected vs link_corruption_suspected verdict only orders the two candidate causes from accompanying decode-layer anomalies; both remain open and the confidence is the same. Operator guidance: services/anomaly-detector/README.md
